allowedAiRole: Retrieve applicable guidance and present questions not conclusions
requiredInputs: Jurisdiction premises use occupancy lease assets and planned changes
principalFailure: Wrong jurisdiction or false universal duty
mandatoryControl: Versioned source links explicit unknowns and professional escalation
killThreshold: Any wrong-jurisdiction answer in a high-consequence evaluation set

allowedAiRole: Extract dates asset identifiers assessor details scope findings and actions
requiredInputs: Original PDFs images registers and metadata
principalFailure: Invented fields OCR error or lost context
mandatoryControl: Field-level provenance confidence and raw-document link

allowedAiRole: Match public register records expiry scope company and individual
requiredInputs: Authoritative registers insurer evidence and engagement scope
principalFailure: Name collision expired credential or scope mismatch
mandatoryControl: Deterministic register check and human approval before routing
killThreshold: Greater than zero critical errors before live provider routing

allowedAiRole: Convert authoritative requirements and operator procedures into a draft template
requiredInputs: Versioned law guidance standards and premises class
principalFailure: Omission outdated reference or generic template applied to complex premises
mandatoryControl: Controlled template library expert approval version lock and change review
killThreshold: Less than 100 percent of mandatory controls represented

allowedAiRole: Map voice text and photos to report fields without adding observations
requiredInputs: Time-stamped assessor notes photos and location context
principalFailure: Fabricated observation or evidence attached to wrong location
mandatoryControl: No-source-no-claim rule assessor confirmation and immutable originals

allowedAiRole: Flag possible visible defects for closer inspection
requiredInputs: Original images asset identity capture conditions and model version
principalFailure: False reassurance hidden condition or spurious defect
mandatoryControl: Never mark compliant from image alone; require inspector disposition
killThreshold: Any missed critical defect in release evaluation

allowedAiRole: Write narrative from accepted findings and controlled references
requiredInputs: Signed site findings source library and report schema
principalFailure: Confabulated rule wrong priority or polished unsupported claim
mandatoryControl: Sentence-level evidence anchors rule version and competent review
killThreshold: Greater than 0.5 percent or any critical unsupported sentence

allowedAiRole: Propose editable actions owners and timescales
requiredInputs: Confirmed defect severity source and premises context
principalFailure: Unsafe remedy false deadline or commercial bias
mandatoryControl: Separate statutory requirement from recommendation and require assessor edit

allowedAiRole: Create reminders request evidence and open tasks
requiredInputs: Verified cadence change triggers and asset status
principalFailure: Treating guidance as fixed law or closing work without evidence
mandatoryControl: Rules engine controls dates; AI may communicate but cannot invent closure
killThreshold: Greater than 2 percent overdue critical actions attributable to automation

allowedAiRole: Shortlist providers by coverage scope credentials capacity and conflict
requiredInputs: Verified provider graph current registers insurance service scope and availability
principalFailure: Unqualified provider concentration or undisclosed conflict
mandatoryControl: Human approval two-provider fallback and reason codes
killThreshold: Greater than 5 percent reversals or any credential breach

allowedAiRole: Flag unusual readings missing checks repeat defects and stalled actions
requiredInputs: Structured longitudinal asset and work-order data
principalFailure: Alert fatigue bad baselines or missed novel hazard
mandatoryControl: Site-specific thresholds human disposition and monitored precision recall
killThreshold: Recall below 95 percent on defined critical anomaly set

allowedAiRole: Rank open work by consequence deadline confidence and exposure
requiredInputs: Approved risk model confirmed findings occupancy and deadlines
mandatoryControl: Risk owner approves queue; unknowns receive conservative escalation
killThreshold: Below 95 percent agreement with blinded expert panel

allowedAiRole: AI may assemble the closure packet but may not attest that work is compliant
requiredInputs: Completion evidence provider sign-off and dutyholder acceptance
mandatoryControl: Named human acceptance immutable audit event and reopen path

allowedAiRole: No autonomous certification accreditation claim or professional signature
requiredInputs: Physical examination measurements competence and professional judgement
principalFailure: Fraud misrepresentation injury or invalid certificate
mandatoryControl: Only authorised competent person may sign; AI authorship and edits logged
